options.content:
# Notes

In the diagrams below, outbound and inbound are considered for the connection initiator.

For example, when using an exporter on a web server, the connection is initiated by remote clients. This means that outbound will indicate the amount of traffic sent to the server. Meanwhile, inbound will indicate the amount of traffic sent from the server to the client.
